all_success_cost.selection_rule: Each interface independently includes every successful measured episode with valid native token audits. No seed matching or equal-count subsampling; failed and unfinished episodes excluded from success-only means.

allegro_v5.orientation_adjustment_basis: Rotate fixed palm mount 180 degrees about local/world X so the nominal pointing configuration clears the floor; no joint, actuator or task threshold changes.

robotiq_reachability.method: Planar coupled jaw kinematics; perpendicular distance of frozen goals to fixed jaw-tip plane
